items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: To Jamacica when Michael Manley was the president; was a socialist president we have there.

ctx.x: How did the band begin touring?
It was complicated; the first trips were to communist countries. Still, the Berlin wall was there. So, our first tour was Bulgaria and Hungary, not Czechoslovakia and the Soviet

Union. So, the first travel to, the first time we travel to a free country, was to Jamaica. To Jamacica when Michael Manley was the president; was a socialist president we have there. And then, we, it was very interesting because they put in my room, they put me to share the room a member of the communist party, in order to keep an eye on me. But the problem is that the guy who was appointed to be my guard, he was my, he told me that he was there for that. [Willard laughs] The name of this guy was Enrique Pla,…
